verdict.rationale: The CRA's only programmatic channel in the evidence is EFILE, where certified tax software and an enrolled electronic filer transmit returns system-to-system. That channel is gated by a CRA certification process, covers only return filing, and the pack contains no public API reference; the probe found no llms.txt or agent-oriented docs index on canada.ca. Missing for 10: an openly documented public API reference, self-serve developer access, API coverage beyond return filing (registration, payments, enquiries), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: certified software plus an enrolled electronic filer transmit returns system-to-system

electronically file their clients' current and first seven prior years' income tax and benefit return information to the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) directly from their EFILE–certified tax preparation software

the developer of the tax preparation software has gone through a process with the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) to verify that their product is compatible with the CRA EFILE electronic tax filing service.
